name: Ozark
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Ozark, MO 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Ozark, MO for 2026: the Festival of Lights, Dashing Through the Glow and the Sparta parade, with prices checked.
lede: Ozark lights Finley River Park every year with a free drive-thru, and adds a tree lighting, a chamber parade and a lights run.
celebrates: The City of Ozark runs the Festival of Lights at Finley River Park, a free drive-thru with more than a mile of displays that it calls one of its most cherished holiday traditions. Some displays show pieces of the town's history, such as the Old Mill, and donations at the end of the route help maintain them. The city opens the season with the Mayor's Tree Lighting, and the Ozark Chamber of Commerce hosts the Christmas Parade through historic downtown, the 61st annual in 2026. On December 12 families can walk or run the same lights in the Dashing Through the Glow 1-mile run.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Ozark's holiday events, so this page leans on the city's own 2026 listings. The city's calendar lists the Mayor's Tree Lighting as an annual event, the chamber calls its parade the 61st annual in 2026, and the Festival of Lights is described by the city as a long running tradition that returns each November.
facts: The Festival of Lights is set in Finley River Park, which the city says has three pavilions painted red, yellow and blue. The park sits just off Highway 14. The 2026 festival gates open nightly from 5:30 to 10 pm from November 21 through December 27. An earlier city listing described the drive-through lights as an Ozark event that begins with the Mayor's Tree Lighting.
trains: Ozark does not have its own holiday train. The closest ride is in Springfield, where the Railroad Historical Museum is listed on our museum guide, and Branson Scenic Railway runs The Polar Express about 40 miles south.

faq: The City of Ozark runs a free Festival of Lights drive-thru at Finley River Park each year, opens the season with a Mayor's Tree Lighting and works with the chamber on a Christmas parade through historic downtown.
Is the Ozark Festival of Lights free?
Yes, the city runs it as a free drive-thru. Donations are welcome at the end of the route to maintain the displays. It runs nightly from November 21 through December 27, 2026.
Where can kids see Santa near Ozark?
Santa visits after Dashing Through the Glow on December 12 for cocoa and cookies, and Santa and Mrs. Claus pose for photos before the Sparta Christmas Parade on December 5.
Are there Christmas parades near Ozark?
Ozark held its 61st chamber parade on November 21. Sparta holds its parade on December 5 at 6 pm, and Nixa's parade is on December 6 at 2 pm.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Ozark for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the Festival of Lights at Finley River Park) through December 27 (the Festival of Lights), with the Sparta Christmas Parade and Santa Photos (December 5) and Dashing Through the Glow (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Ozark

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Ozark
  • 2 free events, the Festival of Lights at Finley River Park and the Sparta Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Santa and Mrs. Claus for photos before the Sparta parade (December 5) and cocoa, cookies and Santa after Dashing Through the Glow (December 12)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Sparta Christmas Parade (December 5); Ozark's own tree lighting and parade were November 20 and 21
  • Lights: the free Festival of Lights drive-thru (to December 27) and the Dashing Through the Glow lights run (December 12)
  • Season: November 27 to December 27

Planning a bigger day out? Ozark families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Springfield, which covers the Springfield Ballet's Nutcracker, Gardens Aglow and the Springfield Symphony.
